people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
translations.bsb: This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear came over all of them. So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
translations.kjv: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
translations.asv: And this became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, that dwelt at Ephesus; and fear fell upon them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
